capabilities.inspect.summary: Search the registered fmcad operation catalog and cad-v1 helpers offline, with prerequisites, limitations and catalog examples.
limitations: This is an exact inventory of catalog registrations and documented cad-v1 helpers, not proof that a native SDK build or model can execute them.
Native SDK probing is a separate explicit broker-port operation; inspect, help, tool listing and search never trigger it.
Precision, coverage, mutation restoration and current document identity remain unknown unless a capability-specific result supplies evidence.

inputs.query: Optional problem or method text. Searches registered operation names, descriptions, inputs, examples, limitations and helper metadata; accented characters are normalized.
inputs.limit: Optional page size from 1 to 100; defaults to 50.
inputs.offset: Optional zero-based result offset; defaults to 0. nextOffset is null when the search is complete.

capabilities.probe.summary: Explicitly request one read-only native SDK capability probe through the broker for a catalogued SDK operation and pinned document identity.
limitations: The SDK probe is distinct from offline inspect and must receive the explicit broker SDK probe port; direct transport calls are rejected.
A result qualifies only the requested capability, selected backend/build and pinned document identity. It does not certify geometry, cloud access or other capabilities.
Unsupported, missing, stale, partial, blocked and unknown evidence remain non-passing; there is no fallback, automatic retry or replay.

inputs.capabilityId: Required registered catalog operation ID. Unregistered IDs return missing; catalog entries that require no SDK return unsupported without a native call.
